recent_articles.title: CM Omar Abdullah seeks INDIA bloc’s support for J&K Statehood restoration - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Omar Abdullah**, the Chief Minister of **Jammu and Kashmir**, sought support from members of the **INDIA bloc** to restore statehood and constitutional rights for the region. He requested their participation in a protest march during the upcoming Monsoon Session of Parliament, which he plans to address individually to each bloc leader. The Supreme Court had previously called for early restoration of Statehood following the 2024 Assembly election won by **NC**.

recent_articles.title: DMK absent, allies restive, INDIA bloc braces for a difficult conversation at today’s meeting | Political Pulse News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Opposition INDIA bloc is set to meet in Delhi on Monday, facing a weakened position after the recent Assembly elections and internal tensions. The absence of the DMK due to its disagreement with the Congress over the Tamil Nadu government's formation has added to the complexity.  **Mamata Banerjee**, **Abhishek Banerjee**, and other leaders are expected to play a mediating role as the bloc grapples with issues including electoral rolls, delimitation, simultaneous elections, education system concerns, and coordination.

recent_articles.title: J&K tribal leader who protested at demolition site faces charges of ‘attempt to murder, rioting with deadly weapons’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Talib Hussain Choudhary**, a tribal leader and member of the **Peoples Democratic Party (PDP)**, was arrested on June 1st in Jammu after organizing a protest against the demolition of tribal structures. He faces charges of attempted murder, rioting, and possessing deadly weapons, according to an FIR filed at the Bagh-e-Bahu police station. The police allege that Choudhary led a gathering of approximately 100-150 people who obstructed public movement and pelted stones at police officers while attempting to march towards the National Highway. **Mehbooba Mufti**, former Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir, criticized the arrest, stating it was an unfair response to Choudhary's peaceful protest for the rights of his community.

recent_articles.title: In Kashmir, a stir over Mehbooba’s ‘review’ of AIIMS | India News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mehbooba Mufti**, former chief minister of Jammu and Kashmir, visited the under-construction AIIMS Awantipora to review its progress. The visit sparked controversy, with the **National Conference** calling it an "unconstitutional step" and a "precedent."  The party's spokesperson, Tanvir Sadiq, stated that the PDP is being reactivated to counter the NC's demands for statehood restoration. **People’s Conference** president Sajad Lone criticized Mufti's visit as a constitutional crisis, while MLA Waheed ur Rehman Para questioned the project's delay and criticized the chief minister for prioritizing party affairs over healthcare. The over Rs 2,000 crore project was announced in 2015 under the Prime Minister’s Development Package (PMDP).

recent_articles.title: Mehbooba Mufti requests Health Minister Nadda to expedite work at AIIMS Awantipora - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mehbooba Mufti**, president of the **Peoples Democratic Party (PDP)**, met with **Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda** to request the expedited completion of the upcoming **AIIMS Awantipora**.  Mufti visited the site and expressed concern that its construction was behind schedule, stating it is crucial for providing quality medical services in Jammu and Kashmir given the current state of healthcare infrastructure. **Nadda** assured her of the project's timely completion.

recent_articles.title: Mehbooba Mufti requests Health Minister Nadda to expedite work at AIIMS Awantipora - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mehbooba Mufti**, president of the **Peoples Democratic Party (PDP)**, met with **Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda** on June 6, 2026, to request the expedited completion of the upcoming **AIIMS Awantipora**.  She expressed concern about potential delays and emphasized the need for the facility's timely opening to improve healthcare in Jammu and Kashmir. **Nadda** assured her of its timely completion.

recent_articles.title: J&K Health Minister takes exception to Mehbooba touring AIIMS, says ‘suffering from political amnesia’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sakeena Itoo**, **Jammu and Kashmir Health Minister**, criticized former Chief Minister **Mehbooba Mufti** for visiting the under-construction AIIMS, Awantipora site.  Itoo accused those who delayed the project of now attempting to claim credit for its progress. **Mufti Muhammad Sayeed**, a PDP leader, had envisioned the project in 2015. **Ms. Mufti** visited the site and requested **J.P. Nadda**, **Union Health Minister**, to expedite its completion.

recent_articles.title: Mehbooba Mufti Party Leader Arrested For Throwing Stones At Police In J&K
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Talib Hussain**, leader of the **People's Democratic Party**, was arrested for allegedly throwing stones at police during a protest in Jammu, India. The incident occurred after authorities demolished illegal structures on state land in Sidhra, leading to unrest and clashes with law enforcement.  The police used tear gas and fired warning shots to disperse the crowd, but no injuries were reported. An FIR has been registered against Hussain and others involved.

recent_articles.title: No inquiry needed: J-K High Court says President, Governor can terminate govt employees over ‘security of state’ | India News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.sentiment_target: Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh High Court
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh High Court** has upheld the dismissal of a police constable, Ghulam Mohammad Tantray, by the then Governor based on Article 311(2)(c) of the Constitution. The court ruled that the President or Governor can remove employees from government service without an inquiry if it is deemed necessary for the security of the state.  The court acknowledged that this provision has a high threshold and requires subjective satisfaction, considering factors like terrorism, espionage, or anti-national conduct. This decision comes amidst criticism of the Jammu and Kashmir Lieutenant Governor's administration for dismissing 91 employees under Article 311(2)(c) since 2021.

recent_articles.title: NC’s Farooq Abdullah backs Hosabale and Naravane’s stand on talks with Pakistan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Farooq Abdullah**, president of the **National Conference**, praised statements by **Dattatreya Hosabale**, general secretary of the **Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh**, and former Army Chief **M.M. Naravane** advocating dialogue between India and Pakistan to resolve issues.  Abdullah expressed hope that the **BRICS** bloc would exert pressure for peace in the Middle East, while also hoping China would play a role. Former J&K Chief Minister **Mehbooba Mufti** welcomed Hosabale's remarks and supported engagement with Pakistan. Jammu and Kashmir Apni Party president **Altaf Bukhari** emphasized the need for dialogue between India and its people in J&K to address their concerns.

recent_articles.title: Ever since Elon Musk took over, banning social media accounts became common: Iltija Mufti - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Iltija Mufti**, daughter of former Chief Minister Mehbooba Mufti, is considering legal action against **Meta** for withholding her Twitter and Facebook accounts.  She claims she was not notified before the accounts were suspended and has been unable to contact **Meta**.  Ms. Mufti believes this is part of a pattern of silencing voices critical of the government in Kashmir. She argues that banning political social media accounts is an attack on democracy.

recent_articles.title: NC, PDP in war of words over Rajya Sabha polls, closure of seminary, ‘sidelining’ Urdu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Omar Abdullah**, **J&K Chief Minister**, inaugurated a sports complex in Tangmarg, while **Mehbooba Mufti**, PDP president, criticized the NC for using the Rajya Sabha election results and the closure of the Siraj-ul-Aloom school as political tools. The NC accused the PDP of not appointing polling agents during the Rajya Sabha elections, while the PDP claimed the NC was diverting attention from substantive concerns like the Urdu language erasure and the Waqf Bill.

recent_articles.title: BJP closing seminaries with the help of J&K government: Mehbooba Mufti - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mehbooba Mufti**, former **Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir**, criticized the **Omar Abdullah government** for its actions against religious institutions and Urdu language. She accused the government of silencing the closure of educational institutes like Siraj-ul-Uloom in Shopian, which provided education to underprivileged children, and Hazratbal seminary, both allegedly targeted by the BJP. Mufti also stated that the removal of Urdu from revenue department job qualifications represents an attack on Kashmir's identity and culture.

recent_articles.title: Kashmir seminary declared unlawful under Indian law, sparks outcry | Religion News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: An important Islamic seminary in Indian-administered Kashmir, Jamia Siraj-ul-Uloom, has been declared unlawful under anti-terror laws.  **Kashmir Divisional Commissioner Anshul Garg** issued the order based on a police dossier alleging links to the banned political party Jamaat-e-Islami (JeI). **Mohammad Shafi Lone**, the seminary chairman, rejected the allegations and called the move a “calculated dismantling of Kashmir’s civic life.” Leaders in Muslim-majority Kashmir criticized the decision as part of an ongoing campaign of overreach by New Delhi.

recent_articles.title: Omar, Mehbooba slam closure of Jama Masjid on Id, Hazratbal prayer omission for Iran, Palestine - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister Omar Abdullah** and **Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) president Mehbooba Mufti** criticized the closure of the historic Jama Masjid in Srinagar for Id prayers, while also expressing concern over the omission of special prayers for Iran, Palestine, and Lebanon from the Hazratbal shrine. The **Anjuman Auqaf Jama Masjid**, the caretaker body of the mosque, alleged that restrictions were imposed on congregational prayers at the historic site.  **Kashmir chief cleric Mirwaiz Umar Farooq** was allegedly placed under house arrest, while **J&K Waqf Board head Darakshan Andrabi** faced criticism for dropping Iran, Palestine, and Lebanon from special prayers.

recent_articles.title: Mirwaiz ‘barred’ from Friday prayers at Srinagar’s Jamia Masjid - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mirwaiz Umar Farooq**, the Kashmir chief cleric, was barred from praying at the historic Jamia Masjid in Srinagar due to heightened tensions stemming from the Iran-U.S. war. **Farooq** stated that he was placed under house arrest and prevented from delivering his weekly sermon.  Several regional leaders, including **Farooq Abdullah**, attended congregational prayers in Srinagar. **Mehbooba Mufti**, the Peoples Democratic Party president, expressed concern over rising violence against Muslims in New Delhi and urged the Prime Minister and Home Minister to intervene.

recent_articles.title: Uttam Nagar violence: Mehbooba Mufti seeks PM Modi's intervention ahead of Id - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mehbooba Mufti**, president of the **PDP**, called for intervention from **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Union Home Minister Amit Shah** to quell communal tensions in Delhi's Uttam Nagar.  She expressed concern over escalating violence following a Holi clash, urging authorities to prevent further bloodshed before Eid. The tension stems from the death of Tarun, who was killed in a dispute with his neighbors, which escalated into protests and vandalism by Hindu groups.
